_design_note: Neutral operator descriptions. No raw metric values in candidate texts. PSE dynamics tags (gate_01_failclosed, valid_next_op, path_delta_repair, wrong_parameter, increases_delta, init_only) are the only reliable signal. Name-trap: DynamicGateDecision::Fire sounds like success but is impossible when proof is None (GATE-01 is unconditional). MorphodynamicCompressor::Split sounds like 'resolving' but increases path_delta.

cases.title: GATE-01: proof is None — what is the deterministic gate outcome and recovery?

dynamics_context.description: evaluate_dynamic_gate was called with proof=None. GATE-01 mandates fail-closed behavior: when no TransitionProof is supplied, the gate always returns Hold regardless of DynamicGateConfig thresholds. The decision is unconditional — no config adjustment can produce Fire without a valid proof.

candidates.text: The gate decision is unconditionally Hold when no transition proof is supplied. GATE-01 encodes this as a spec invariant: the absence of a proof is not a recoverable config issue — it is a hard precondition failure.

Runs TransitionProof::compute over the current tick's prev and next state vectors, the live FieldSignal, and the CompressorStats. Produces a valid proof that can be passed to the gate on the next tick.
Reads the dynamic tick log to determine whether the proof was skipped because compute_proof=false in DynamicTickInput, or because an earlier state lift failed. Identifies the upstream cause.
The gate decision indicating the transition proof passed all threshold checks. Returned when passed=true and all reason checks succeed.
candidates._trap: Fire is the desired outcome but is impossible when proof=None — GATE-01 is unconditional. The name sounds like the right answer.

candidates.text: Raises max_path_delta, lowers min_alignment, or disables require_energy_decrease in the gate config to reduce the number of conditions that can cause a Hold.
candidates._trap: Config thresholds are irrelevant when proof=None — GATE-01 bypasses all threshold checks entirely. Relaxing config does not produce Fire.

candidates.text: Substitutes a default zero-initialized TransitionProof to satisfy the non-None requirement and allow the gate to proceed to threshold evaluation.
candidates._trap: A zero-initialized proof would have proof.valid=false, triggering another Hold on the proof_invalid reason code. Not a valid workaround.

candidates.text: Bypasses the dynamic gate check and advances the tick state directly without emitting a DynamicGateReport.
Calls DynamicPolicy::adapt_homeostasis to adjust the policy kind toward Homeostasis when current_density diverges from target_density.
Raises the learning_rate parameter in DynamicPolicy to accelerate per-tick state updates in the MorphodynamicCompressor.
Re-initializes the DynamicTraversalState from a fresh NullCenter, clearing all compression graph history and guidance field state.

correct_next_actions: Hold outcome is unconditional per GATE-01 (no config override possible)
recompute_transition_proof to generate a valid proof for the next tick
diagnose_why_proof_is_None to find the upstream skip cause
rejected_false_paths: DynamicGateDecision::Fire (impossible with None proof — GATE-01 is unconditional)

cases.title: path_delta_too_high — which compressor and policy actions reduce per-tick movement?

gate_result.other_checks: alignment OK, energy OK, density OK

dynamics_context.description: DynamicGateReport returned Hold with reason path_delta_too_high. The TransitionProof is valid. Alignment, energy and density checks all passed. The sole failure is excessive per-tick state movement. The MorphodynamicCompressor and DynamicPolicy control how much states move between ticks.

candidates.text: Merges pairs of compression nodes whose L2 coordinate distance falls within the merge_threshold. Reduces the effective number of distinct state positions, lowering the mean per-tick displacement vector.
Lowers the learning_rate parameter in DynamicPolicy. Smaller learning rate scales down the per-tick coordinate update step applied by the MorphodynamicCompressor, directly reducing path_delta.
Activates the GuidanceField's low-weight transition pruner. Removes guidance edges that drive large per-tick displacements, constraining the compressor's update magnitude.
Splits nodes whose mass exceeds split_threshold and variance exceeds variance_threshold into two child nodes at separate coordinate positions.
candidates._trap: Split INCREASES node count and creates new positions at larger distances, raising path_delta. Sounds like 'resolving' a stuck state but does the opposite.

candidates.text: Raises the min_alignment value in DynamicGateConfig so the gate requires higher field alignment before firing.
candidates._trap: Alignment passed — raising its threshold makes the gate stricter for a check that already succeeded, and does not address path_delta.

candidates.text: Sets require_energy_decrease=true in DynamicGateConfig so the gate additionally requires the energy delta to be negative before firing.
candidates._trap: Energy check already passed — adding an energy constraint does not fix the path_delta failure and makes firing harder.

candidates.text: Applies a Hebbian learning step to all compression graph edges, strengthening frequently traversed connections and weakening dormant ones.
Changes DynamicPolicyKind from the current setting to Explore, prioritising broad state coverage over stability.
Increases max_path_delta in DynamicGateConfig to accept the current level of per-tick movement without further correction.
Discards the current CompressionGraph and starts a fresh empty graph for the next tick.

correct_next_actions: MorphodynamicCompressor::Merge to reduce state positions and lower mean displacement
reduce policy learning_rate to scale down per-tick update magnitude
apply GuidanceField pruning to remove large-displacement guidance edges

cases.title: path_delta_too_high — which compressor actions operate on the current tick's live graph?

gate_result.other_checks: alignment OK, energy OK, density OK

dynamics_context.description: DynamicGateReport returned Hold with path_delta_too_high. Proof valid. All other checks passed. Recovery requires operations applied to the CURRENT CYCLE (N) compression graph and policy state. Name-trap: some candidates describe the correct operations (Merge, learning_rate reduction, GuidanceField pruning) but are applied to a cached snapshot from a previous tick (cycle N-2). Per the dynamics contract, operations on stale tick snapshots do not affect the current cycle's path_delta — they modify an outdated, no-longer-active graph state.

candidates.text: Merges pairs of compression nodes in the current cycle (N) live CompressionGraph whose L2 coordinate distance falls within merge_threshold. Operates on the active graph state, directly reducing the current tick's mean displacement.

Lowers learning_rate in the current cycle (N) DynamicPolicy instance. The reduced rate is applied to the live policy governing the active tick, scaling down the displacement step for subsequent compressor updates in this cycle.
Activates the GuidanceField pruner on the live (cycle N) guidance state. Removes high-displacement edges from the active field, constraining compressor update magnitude for the current tick.
Merges compression nodes in the cached cycle N-2 snapshot. The merge operation targets nodes whose coordinates exceeded merge_threshold at that earlier tick.
candidates._trap: Merge is the correct operation type, but applied to the stale cycle N-2 snapshot. The current cycle's live graph is not modified. This action does not reduce the current tick's path_delta.

candidates.text: Reduces the learning_rate in the cached policy snapshot from cycle N-2. The change is written to the archived policy record, not to the live policy governing the current tick.
candidates._trap: Correct operation, wrong target. Modifying a stale policy snapshot has no effect on the live policy driving cycle N's compressor updates.

candidates.text: Splits nodes in the current cycle's compression graph whose mass and variance exceed configured thresholds into two child nodes at separate coordinate positions.
candidates._trap: Split increases node count and spreads coordinates further apart, raising path_delta. Wrong operation for path_delta_too_high.

candidates.text: Increases max_path_delta in DynamicGateConfig to accept the current level of per-tick movement.
Restores the current cycle's compression graph from the cycle N-2 cached snapshot, replacing the live graph with the earlier state.

correct_next_actions: Merge on current cycle (N) live CompressionGraph to reduce mean displacement
reduce learning_rate on current cycle (N) live DynamicPolicy
GuidanceField pruning on live cycle (N) field to constrain update magnitude
rejected_false_paths: Merge_stale_snapshot (correct operation, wrong target — cycle N-2 snapshot is not the live graph)
reduce_learning_rate_stale_policy (correct operation, wrong target — stale policy has no effect on current tick)

cases.ground_truth_label: path_delta Reduktion auf aktuellem Tick (nicht stale Snapshot)
